Generic POST /api/v1/leads/intake/{source_slug} endpoint, per-tenant API key auth (24h grace period rotation), libphonenumber-csharp E.164 normalize, 30-day duplicate merge window (tenant override), consent checkbox required, 100 req/min per-key rate limit, welcome flow auto-trigger via Hangfire enqueue. Dent Adavista pilot 'ireland-roadshow-lp' source + 'wa-direct' source (wa-direct is Chunk B scope). UI editor Chunk C scope.
plan.q_intent: Q: 'liw' (FEAT-LIW impl). Sprint A (week 1) start, paralel VCP ile planlanacak. Chunk A Backend core, bu session'da bitsin.
plan.interview_notes: 8 interview sorusu cevaplandi (2026-04-18): (1) Phone lib = libphonenumber-csharp (recommended); (2) Field map = raw custom_1..10 standalone (TFM C sprint, not blocker); (3) Consent = explicit checkbox field zorunlu (INV-BE-094 on missing/false); (4) WA direct = mevcut WAA INMA webhook extend (Chunk B scope, this plan sadece landing form scope'u); (5) API key rotation = 24h grace (eski key 24h active, old_key + old_expires_at columns); (6) Welcome flow default = 'welcome_default' platform-default slug (missing ise INV-AT-068 warn + lead yaratilir trigger skip); (7) Dup window = 30g default + `intake_dup_window_days` tenant override; (8) Rate limit = 100 req/min per API key, in-memory sliding window.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/v1/leads/intake/{source_slug} endpoint aktif. X-Invekto-Api-Key header zorunlu. Invalid/missing key -> 401 INV-BE-092. source_slug path param [a-z0-9-]{1,50} regex valide edilir; invalid -> 400 INV-BE-093.

API key rotation 24h grace: tenant_landing_settings tablosu landing_api_key (aktif) + landing_api_key_old + landing_api_key_old_expires_at kolonlariyla olusturulur. Eski key 24h boyunca hala 401 vermez; old_expires_at < NOW() ise 401. UNIQUE INDEX her iki key uzerinde (partial WHERE NOT NULL for old).

Field map JSONB resolve: tenant_landing_settings.landing_field_map -> canonical fields (name, phone, email, consent, custom_1..10). Zorunlu canonical = name, phone, consent. source alan bulunmayinca 400 INV-BE-095 (field_mapping_missing + hangi alan). Optional alanlar (email, custom_*) yoksa null olarak yazilir.

Phone E.164 normalize libphonenumber-csharp ile. Invalid phone -> 400 INV-BE-096. Country hint field map'te `phone.country_hint` (ISO 2-letter) varsa parse hint'i olarak verilir; yoksa IE/TR default deneme. Normalize sonuc: +CC... (no spaces, no hyphens).

Consent validation: payload.fields[consent_source_key] bool `true` olmazsa (null, false, missing, string) -> 400 INV-BE-097. wa-direct path bu Chunk'ta yok; landing form her zaman explicit consent zorunlu.

Duplicate merge window: UNIQUE(tenant_id, phone) mevcut (pkt6b1 uq_leads_tenant_phone). UPSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE: intake_metadata JSONB merge (`||` operator), source_slug overwrite, utm_* fields COALESCE (new priority). Response: duplicate=true if created_at < NOW() - @dupWindow (tenant_landing_settings.intake_dup_window_days default 30). Duplicate gon 'welcome_flow_enqueued=false'.

Welcome flow trigger: lead brand-new (duplicate=false) + tenant_landing_settings.welcome_flow_slug (varsa) veya 'welcome_default' (fallback) -> Backend BackgroundJob.Enqueue<Automation.Services.Jobs.TriggerWelcomeFlowJob>(job => job.ExecuteAsync(tenantId, slug, leadId)). Hangfire queue = `automation`. Slug yoksa ve 'welcome_default' yoksa -> log warn INV-AT-068, flow skip, lead yine yaratilir (silent fail NO, structured warn).

Rate limit 100 req/min per API key: InMemoryApiKeyRateLimiter sliding window. 60s icinde 100. key-> ConcurrentDictionary<string, Queue<DateTime>>. Limit asilirsa 429 INV-BE-098 + Retry-After header (saniye cinsinden, en eski request + 60s - now).

Response 201 sema: { lead_id: int, duplicate: bool, welcome_flow_enqueued: bool }. Errors: 400 (payload/consent/phone/field), 401 (invalid key), 429 (rate limit), 500 (unexpected NpgsqlException wrapped).

Migration 021 applied local/dev: CREATE TABLE tenant_landing_settings + 2 UNIQUE INDEX + ALTER leads (intake_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}' + source_slug VARCHAR(50)). Build PASS sonrasi arch/db/pkt6b1 canonical senkron + arch/db/tenant-landing-settings.sql yeni canonical dosyasi.

deviations.summary: Error code block rebased from INV-BE-092..099 (planned) to INV-BE-100..107; INV-AT-068 kept.
deviations.reason: Pre-existing registry collision — INV-BE-090..095 are already claimed by the Translation + HFM-2 warmup blocks (both arch/errors.md and ErrorCodes.cs). Q approved the rebase before implementation to avoid double-assignment at runtime. The INV-BE-090..095 duplicate-assignment tech debt is pre-existing and orthogonal to LIW.

deviations.summary: Added an optional authExcludedPrefixes parameter to Shared JwtAuthMiddleware (new ctor overload + new UseJwtAuth extension); existing callers untouched.
deviations.reason: Program.cs already registers `/api/v1/leads` as a JWT-required prefix, so the intake path was being caught by JWT before the endpoint could authenticate with X-Invekto-Api-Key. Rather than splitting the leads prefix into many sub-entries (brittle) or moving the intake path off /api/v1/leads/ (contract break), the middleware now supports an exclusion list that wins over inclusions. /api/v1/leads/intake/ is the sole exclusion today; all other /api/v1/leads/* endpoints keep Bearer JWT auth unchanged. JwtAuthMiddleware.cs was added to files_changed (outside original allowed_files) to document this.

deviations.summary: intake_metadata JSONB shape is flat top-level keys per submission (submission_<iso> -> payload snapshot), not a submissions array.
deviations.reason: Postgres JSONB `||` concat is a shallow object-merge; an array shape would be overwritten on every UPSERT. Flat keyed shape lets `||` naturally append each submission without jsonb_set gymnastics. Tenant-side reads iterate object entries filtered by the `submission_` prefix. last_submission_at + last_source_slug duplicate the latest for quick access.

deviations.summary: TriggerWelcomeFlowJob is a Chunk-A placeholder: enqueue resolves + StepInfo logs, actual flow dispatch wired in Chunk B. Response flag renamed welcome_flow_enqueued -> welcome_flow_enqueued after Codex iteration-0 feedback to remove the implication that delivery happened.
deviations.reason: Backend compile-only ProjectReference (G7 §12) needs the type resolvable so BackgroundJob.Enqueue<T> is type-safe. Wiring the real FlowEngine dispatch in Chunk A would drag the Automation slug-resolve repo + FlowEngine into scope; Chunk B owns those changes. The renamed flag now accurately reports what Chunk A DOES guarantee — Hangfire accepted the job for the `automation` queue — while Chunk B fills in the worker-side dispatch. Contract doc + DTO + service + ac_verification all aligned to the new name.

deviations.summary: Duplicate-within-window classification uses `(now - prior.created_at) <= window` — the AC6 text literal (`created_at < NOW() - @dupWindow`) reads BACKWARDS versus the aha_moment + VQ Q2 description, so business-intent wins.
deviations.reason: aha_moment (RELIABILITY) + verification Q2 clearly describe: within window = merge + no welcome (spam protection); outside window = re-engagement + fire welcome again. AC6's literal inequality inverts that. Implemented the business-intent rule; AC6 wording should be corrected in a doc follow-up.

ac_verification.note: POST /api/v1/leads/intake/{source_slug} mapped; X-Invekto-Api-Key required (missing/empty -> 401 INV-BE-100). SlugRegex ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,49}$ gates 400 INV-BE-101 (slightly tighter than plan [a-z0-9-]{1,50} to forbid leading hyphen).

FieldMapResolver.ParseMap + ResolveString enforce Required canonicals (name/phone/consent). Consent-missing emits INV-BE-102; other required-missing emits INV-BE-103 with {field} token. Optional canonicals (email, custom_1..10) stored in intake_metadata.<submission>.resolved when mapped.
PhoneE164Normalizer wraps libphonenumber-csharp. Country hint path first (phone.country_hint), then leading-+ parse, then IE/TR fallback. E.164 formatted output; parse/validate fail -> INV-BE-104.
Consent canonical resolved via ResolveBool; anything != true (null/false/missing/non-bool) -> 400 INV-BE-105. Source-key-missing-from-map is treated as INV-BE-102 at the map-validation step.

UpsertIntakeLeadAsync uses CTE (prior + upserted) for single-roundtrip probe+merge. intake_metadata concat via `||`, source_slug overwrite, utm_* COALESCE-new-priority. Duplicate = (now - prior.created_at) <= tenant dup window; outside window = re-engagement, welcome fires. See DEV-5 for AC6 wording clarification.

BackgroundJob.Enqueue<TriggerWelcomeFlowJob>(tenantId, slug, leadId) fired when duplicate=false. Slug falls back to 'welcome_default' when tenant_landing_settings.welcome_flow_slug is null/blank. Hangfire queue = automation (see [Queue("automation")] attribute). Enqueue exceptions are typed (BackgroundJobClientException, NpgsqlException, InvalidOperationException) and logged with the matching infra code (INV-JOB-001 storage, INV-JOB-002 handler-unresolved). Response flag renamed to `welcome_flow_enqueued` — reflects scheduling, not delivery — per Codex iteration-0 CQ8/9/10. See DEV-4 for Chunk B dispatch wiring.

ApiKeyRateLimiter singleton, ConcurrentDictionary<string,Queue<DateTime>> with per-bucket lock. Pre-DB lookup (rate limits unknown keys too, shields registry from brute-force). Retry-After header emitted when Allowed=false, clamped to [1, 60].

201 body = { lead_id, duplicate, welcome_flow_enqueued } — LeadIntakeResponse with JsonPropertyName. Error envelope = ErrorResponse.Create(code, message, '-'). 503 INV-DB-001 on NpgsqlException (DB unreachable or UPSERT failure) — switched from INV-GEN-003 after Codex iteration-0 CQ12 to give callers a specific diagnostic code.

verification_questions.question: API key auth middleware sadece /api/v1/leads/intake/ prefix'i icin devreye giriyor mu? Diger /api/v1/ route'lar (JWT whitelist'te olanlar) hala JWT auth ile korunuyor mu? UseJwtAuth prefix list'ine /api/v1/leads/intake/ EKLENMEDI (bypass amaci), bu sayede JWT middleware intake'i 401 vermez; ancak LeadIntakeService kendi ApiKeyRateLimiter + TenantLandingSettingsRepository key-lookup yapiyor (O(1) indexed). Silent bypass riski var mi?

Duplicate merge semantiki: UNIQUE(tenant_id, phone) her zaman 1 lead kaydi tutar. UPSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE intake_metadata JSONB concat (`||`), source_slug overwrite (son kazanir), utm_* COALESCE (new priority, existing fallback). 30-gun window = `welcome_flow_enqueued` RETURN flag'i hesaplama (lead.created_at eski ise true, yenise false). Window icinde yeniden submit -> lead update ama welcome flow re-trigger YOK (spam koruma). Window disinda re-engagement welcome trigger OLUR. Data kaybi veya silent-skip riski var mi?

Welcome flow Hangfire enqueue (iter 2+): Backend BackgroundJob.Enqueue<TriggerWelcomeFlowJob> 'automation' queue'una yazar; worker dispatch Chunk-B scope (DEV-4 Q-pre-approved). Enqueue failure best-effort: lead 201 doner, response.warnings array'ine matching infra code eklenir (INV-JOB-001 storage, INV-JOB-002 handler-unresolved); welcome_flow_enqueued = false. INV-AT-068 SADECE Automation worker-side defensive (empty slug guard) — Backend her zaman non-empty slug gonderir ('welcome_default' fallback). Kabul edilebilir mi, yoksa endpoint 503 dondurmeli mi?

Rate limit 100/min per key, in-memory sliding window (ConcurrentDictionary<string, Queue<DateTime>>). Prod'da Backend tek instance (multi-instance scale-out yok); counters instance-local. Gelecekteki scale-out senaryosunda in-memory diverge olur (toplam 200/min gecebilir 2 instance ile). Pilot + Dent icin kabul edilebilir mi? V2 notu plan'da var mi (Redis-backed rate limiter)?

tenant_landing_settings yeni tablo tercih edildi (JSONB `tenant_registry.settings_json` path yerine). Gerekce: (a) api_key indexable O(1) lookup (JSONB path query slower), (b) 2 key + expiry columns structured (partial unique index eski key uzerinde), (c) Gelecek LIW/TFM settings ayni tablo altinda genisleyebilir.
